query: read hedl file directory recursive schema entity

tools.name: hedl_hedl_read
tools.description: Read and parse HEDL files from a directory. Returns parsed document structure with entities and relationships.

path.description: Path to a HEDL file or directory containing .hedl files. Examples: '/workspace/models/entity.hedl', '/data/schemas/user.hedl', '/tmp/unrelated/config.json'.

recursive.description: If path is a directory, whether to search recursively. Examples: 'true', 'false'.

include_json.description: Include JSON representation of parsed documents. Examples: 'false', 'true'.
